init.title: Guest access
init.description: Guest and wallet access default off. SOLBUDDY uses Home Assistant network interfaces, URLs, and trusted proxies automatically. Enabled guest controls work on local HTTP (unencrypted) and remote HTTPS. Wallet signatures require HTTPS and a fresh US$2 SBUD valuation. Open SOLBUDDY Access in the sidebar to manage grants using your HA login.

data.wallet_enabled: Enable owner-approved wallets (Phantom, Solflare, Trust; US$2 SBUD minimum)
